literal.prompt: Какой император учредил III отделение Собственной Его Императорского Величества канцелярии в 1826 году?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Presidential Library article identifies Nicholas I as the emperor whose decree established the Third Department in 1826 (L44,L46); it distinguishes Alexander I’s Special Chancellery predecessor (L46), Alexander II’s separate 1880 commission (L58-L59), and Peter I’s separate early eighteenth-century institutions in the second retained article (618969 L44-L45). These concrete period and institution distinctions make Nicholas I the only key.

literalGroups.literal: Николай I учредил III отделение указом от 15 июля 1826 года. Он преобразовал в самостоятельное учреждение уже существовавшую Особенную канцелярию.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained primary article states that the Third Department was established by Nicholas I’s decree on 15 July 1826 and that the Special Chancellery was made an independent institution under its new name.

literalGroups.literal: При Александре I была создана Особенная канцелярия, которую Николай I преобразовал в III отделение.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The article says the Special Chancellery was created during Alexander I’s reign and later transformed by Nicholas I into the independent Third Department.

literalGroups.literal: Николай I указом 1826 года преобразовал Особенную канцелярию в самостоятельное Третье отделение.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The article directly states that Nicholas I’s 1826 decree transformed the Special Chancellery into an independent institution named the Third Department. This adds the predecessor/organizational-change fact beyond the prompt’s ruler, department, and year.

literalGroups.literal: После покушения на Александра II в феврале 1880 года учредили Верховную распорядительную комиссию.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The article says that after the attempt on Alexander II’s life, the Supreme Administrative Commission was created in February 1880.

literalGroups.literal: В январе 1722 года Пётр I учредил должность генерал-прокурора.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The other retained Presidential Library article states that Peter I issued the decree establishing the office of General Procurator in January 1722.
